_meta.description: Triggered directly from Microsoft Teams — an analyst posts a channel message with an appraisal review PDF attached, then runs this flow on that specific message via the Teams Workflows app's message context menu ('For a selected message'). This flow validates the attachment, calls the 'Appraisal Review Extractor' agent's callable extraction topic to do the field extraction, parses and validates the agent's response, copies the bank's own appraisal review template to a new workbook, writes the extracted values into that workbook's named cells (sheet 'RE Collateral'), and replies in the same message thread with the result — since there is no bot conversation, this flow owns all analyst-facing communication.
_meta.invokedBy: Microsoft Teams 'For a selected message' trigger (Teams Workflows app, message context menu) — not by Copilot Studio, a SharePoint event, or an HTTP caller
connectors: Microsoft Teams (shared_teams) — trigger ('For a selected message'), plus the reply action used for every outcome (success, extraction failure, rejection)
SharePoint (shared_sharepointonline) — resolving the attachment's file properties/content, Copy file, Get file properties, Create sharing link

Microsoft Copilot Studio (shared_CopilotStudio or your tenant's equivalent connector id) — Run a topic, to call the agent's callable extraction topic. VERIFY THIS CONNECTOR IS NOT GROUPED WITH shared_powervirtualagents IN YOUR DLP POLICY before relying on this design.
Excel Online (Business) (shared_excelonlinebusiness) — Run script, to populate the named cells listed in _meta.cellMap
costNotes: This flow still makes no AI Builder connector call of any kind — the LLM call happens inside the agent's callable topic (an inline Prompt action, see agent/appraisal-agent-topic.yaml). This flow's own connector list is Teams + SharePoint + Copilot Studio + Excel Online.

The Teams trigger only fires when an analyst explicitly runs this flow on a specific message — unlike a SharePoint folder-drop or an automatic 'new channel message' trigger, this design never runs on messages nobody asked it to process, which keeps generative spend tied to deliberate requests only.
Validate_Attachment (attachment count/type) and Validate_Size (file size) both run — and can both reject — before Call_Extraction_Agent, so a malformed or oversized selection never reaches the agent.

One Copilot Studio topic invocation per valid, explicitly-triggered run is the variable cost — the underlying LLM cost of reading the PDF has not changed from earlier versions of this design, only how the flow is started and how it reports back.
Cell population still uses the standard Excel Online (Business) 'Run script' (Office Scripts) action — no Premium connector, no custom Azure Function.
This version still creates one new file per review, copied from your existing template, for the same reasons as before (matches the bank's existing review-package convention).

trigger.description: 'For a selected message' — a Microsoft Teams manual trigger, surfaced to analysts via the Teams Workflows app's message context menu ('...' on a message > Workflows > this flow, or 'More actions' > 'Workflows' depending on your Teams client version). Uses the standard Teams connector (shared_teams) — not shared_powervirtualagents, and not a Premium HTTP trigger. The exact connector operation id/path varies by Teams connector version in your tenant; build this trigger by searching 'Microsoft Teams' > 'For a selected message' in the designer rather than relying on this JSON's literal path value — see DEPLOYMENT.md, Part E.

Filter_Pdf_Attachments.description: Bot Framework Activity shape (which Teams messages are internally): triggerBody()?['attachments'] is an array of {name, contentType, contentUrl}. Isolates anything that looks like a PDF by filename.

Get_Attachment_Properties.description: Resolves size for the size guardrail before any content is read. Translating a Teams attachment's contentUrl into the siteUrl/filePath pair this action needs is the fiddly part of this design — confirm the exact expression against your tenant's SharePoint connector and how Teams-uploaded files resolve in your environment; see DEPLOYMENT.md, Part E, action 3.

Call_Extraction_Agent.description: Calls the 'Appraisal Review Extractor' agent's callable extraction topic (agent/appraisal-agent-topic.yaml, trigger kind OnInvokeTopic) via the Copilot Studio connector's 'Run a topic' action — a different connector than the DLP-blocked 'When Copilot Studio calls a flow' trigger this design intentionally avoids.

Reply_Success_In_Thread.description: Replies in the same channel conversation as the triggering message, using the trigger's own messageId/channelId/teamId — no hardcoded notification channel needed, since the trigger already tells us exactly where the analyst posted.

body.body: @concat('Created ', outputs('Build_Destination_File_Name'), '. ', if(equals(body('Parse_Agent_Response')?['needsManualReview'], true), concat('Needs manual verification: ', join(coalesce(body('Parse_Agent_Response')?['missingFields'], createArray()), ', '), '. ', coalesce(body('Parse_Agent_Response')?['extractionNotes'], '')), 'All 17 fields were extracted with no flags.'), ' Open the workbook: ', body('Create_Sharing_Link')?['link'])

Reply_Extraction_Failure_In_Thread.description: The agent's own topic-level parse check (parseSucceeded output) failed. No file is created in this branch.

body.body: Extraction failed: the agent could not produce valid data from this document. No workbook was created. Route it to manual review, or re-run this workflow if this looks like a transient issue.

Reply_Rejection_In_Thread_Size.description: Attachment is a PDF but over the 15 MB cap. The agent was never called — no generative cost was spent on this upload.

body.body: This attachment is larger than the 15 MB limit for this workflow. Please split or compress the document, or route it to manual review.

Reply_Rejection_In_Thread_Attachment.description: The triggering message did not have exactly one PDF attached (zero, or more than one). The agent was never called.

body.body: This workflow needs the message it's run on to have exactly one PDF attached. Please attach a single appraisal review PDF and run the workflow again.

Handle_Write_Failure.description: Fires if the file copy, cell population, or sharing-link step failed after a successful extraction — most commonly a misconfigured templateFilePath/destinationFolderPath parameter, the Office Script not present on the copied file, or a sheet name mismatch ('RE Collateral'). Left as an internal diagnostic Compose (matching earlier versions of this flow) rather than a Teams reply, since by this point the run has already failed deep enough that a clean reply payload isn't guaranteed to be available — check run history rather than expecting a Teams message for this specific failure mode.

inputs.errorMessage: The run failed before a Teams reply could be sent. Check the flow's run history for the specific failed action.

environmentId.description: The Power Platform environment ID that hosts the Appraisal Review Extractor agent.

appraisalAgentId.description: The bot/agent ID of 'Appraisal Review Extractor' in Copilot Studio.

extractionTopicName.description: The name of the callable extraction topic within the agent (agent/appraisal-agent-topic.yaml).

teamsFilesSiteUrl.description: The SharePoint site backing the Team(s)/channel(s) this flow is available in — Teams-uploaded files live in this site's document library under the hood. Used to resolve attachment properties/content from the trigger's contentUrl. If this flow is shared across multiple Teams with different backing sites, see DEPLOYMENT.md Part E for how to generalize this parameter.

templateSiteUrl.description: SharePoint site that hosts the bank's own appraisal review template workbook (sheet 'RE Collateral').

templateFilePath.description: Server-relative path to the template file within templateSiteUrl.

destinationSiteUrl.description: SharePoint site where completed, per-review workbooks should be saved.

destinationFolderPath.description: Server-relative destination folder path within destinationSiteUrl.
